verdicts.reason: A: the GLACIER wordmark sits under the headline, so the reading order is wrong. A huge empty band separates the top copy from the CTA, and the CTA is centred while all the text is left-aligned. The flavour pills are tiny, wrap awkwardly 2+1 with BLOOD ORANGE indented out of line, and sit below the CTA. B has the same wordmark-under-headline order and a big dead middle, and its top copy group is cramped, with the headline over the decorative circle. Its pills are inconsistent: BLOOD ORANGE has smaller type than the others and touches CUCUMBER MINT. Still, B keeps the flavours as one grouped row above the CTA, which reads slightly better than A's scattered pills.
